messages:
sara_sales: Hey team — Customer (Acero) has a product demo Thurs 11:00 PDT, expecting a short spike ~120 concurrent requests for ~15 min. Can we get a scoped ephemeral hosted key + temporary QPS ramp to 250 qps for the window? Need IP allowlist too.

ben_infra: @sara_sales can you paste the exact window (start/end), expected RPS per second, and the client IP ranges? Also any PII concerns?

sara_sales: Start 2027-08-12T18:50:00Z, end 2027-08-12T19:10:00Z (20m). Burst to 250 qps, steady ~60 qps. IPs: 54.233.160.0/24 and 3.235.5.0/24. No PII in requests — demo uses synthetic prompts.

maya_se: thanks. For hosted keys we can do a scoped ephemeral key tied to that window and IPs. We'll need eng-infra to approve the quota bump. Can you confirm query length / model? (helps size token budget)

sara_sales: model: rlhf-large-v2 (approx 512 tokens avg per request incl. response). Estimate ~60k tokens total for window.

eli_support: looping in @ben_infra and @deploy-bot for provisioning. Also FYI if they need streaming, connection count matters too.

deploy-bot: Created request ID: req_20270812_1987. Ticket auto-assigned to eng-infra oncall.

ben_infra: I can approve a temporary soft quota bump for that window up to 300 qps with scoped key and IP allowlist. I'll need a signed customer PO? for production billing but for demo we can do a 0-day exception. I'll provision scoped key and add fallback policy to route to a cheaper model if latency spikes.

sara_sales: Awesome — no PO required for this demo. Prefer scoped key that expires 30m after window end.

maya_se: I'll generate the scoped key and test locally. Also adding a simple canary rule: first 10% of requests go to rlhf-medium for degradation check, rest to rlhf-large-v2. If failures >5% auto-failover to rlhf-medium.

deploy-bot: Scoped key created: sk_live_scoped_******** (ephemeral). Expires 2027-08-12T19:40:00Z. Added IP allowlist for 54.233.160.0/24, 3.235.5.0/24.

sara_sales: Received it — thanks :raised_hands: Can you post the curl example so the customer can test?

maya_se: sure — here's minimal example:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_scoped_********" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rlhf-large-v2","input":"hello","max_tokens":256}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
```

ben_infra: Quick note: we'll monitor token burn and latency. If tail latency exceeds 800ms for >2min we'll throttle to 150 qps and notify the thread. I'll also enable prefix caching for repeated prompts to reduce tokens.

eli_support: I'll prepare a short post-demo rundown for billing/usage and send to you @sara_sales. Also attached an answer to their security Q: we only store request metadata for 7 days unless configured otherwise.

sara_sales: perfect. thanks everyone. Tagging @legal for FYI re: demo exception. :slightly_smiling_face:

ben_infra: Done — monitoring on. Ping me if they want to extend window.

sara_sales: will do. closing after demo, appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
